teaser: Gravel dust and the tick of a cooling engine fill a trailhead parking lot before anyone else has laced up. You are life path 1, an ISFP, and what's particular about this crossing is how quietly the pull to lead sits inside someone built to feel first and explain never. The 1 asks for a life out front; the ISFP would rather the work speak before the person does. What shows up is a kind of leadership that doesn't announce itself until it has already moved, decided in private and handed over finished.
excerpt: The screen door that sticks halfway, no matter who tries it.
